# NSF - U.S. National Science Foundation

> The NSF is an independent federal agency that supports fundamental research and education in science and engineering across the United States, offering diverse funding opportunities for researchers at all career stages.

NSF provides comprehensive funding programs, policies, and award management resources for academic institutions, industry partners, and individual researchers. The foundation administers competitive grants through a merit-based review process and supports initiatives ranging from undergraduate research experiences to translational entrepreneurial projects.

## Key Topics

- NSF Funding Opportunities
- Merit Review Process
- PAPPG (Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide)
- STEM Education and Research
- Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU)
- Convergence Accelerator
- America's Seed Fund (SBIR/STTR)
- Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
- Career Development Awards
- Award Management and Reporting
- Research.gov and Grants.gov
- Postdoctoral Fellowships
- Early-Career Researchers
- Industry Engagement
- Translational Research

## Getting Started with NSF Funding

- [NSF - U.S. National Science Foundation](https://www.nsf.gov): NSF homepage: independent federal agency supporting science and engineering research funding
- [Getting Started - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/getting-started): Guide for new applicants to understand NSF funding opportunities and application process
- [NSF Initiatives - Funding](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives): Overview of NSF cross-cutting funding initiatives including Convergence Accelerator and EPSCoR

## Funding Opportunities by Career Stage

- [Information for Undergraduates - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/undergraduates): Undergraduate funding opportunities including REU and international research programs
- [NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/reu): REU program offering undergraduate research opportunities in science and engineering
- [Funding for Graduate Students - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/graduate-students): Graduate funding including GRFP and research internships for graduate students
- [Opportunities for Early-Career Researchers - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/early-career-researchers): Funding opportunities for early-career faculty including CAREER and BRC-BIO programs
- [Funding for Postdoctoral Researchers - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/postdocs): Postdoctoral funding opportunities including Engineering Fellows and fellowship programs

## Industry and Entrepreneurial Funding

- [Industry: Engaging with NSF - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/industry): Industry funding programs including SBIR/STTR and America's Seed Fund for startups
- [Information for Entrepreneurial Researchers - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/entrepreneurs): Entrepreneurial funding including SBIR and Convergence Accelerator for translational research

## Proposal Preparation and Submission

- [Preparing Your Proposal - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/preparing-proposal): Guide to preparing NSF proposals with PAPPG guidelines and proposal requirements
- [Submitting Your Proposal - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/submitting-proposal): Instructions for submitting proposals via Research.gov and Grants.gov with registration requirements
- [NSF Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG)](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/pappg): Official NSF PAPPG reference document for proposal and award policies and procedures

## Funding Decisions and Merit Review

- [How We Make Funding Decisions - Funding at NSF](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/merit-review): Explanation of NSF merit review process and funding decision criteria

## Award Management and Compliance

- [Manage Your Award](https://www.nsf.gov/awards): Central hub for award management including financial compliance and reporting requirements
- [Request a Change to Your Award - Manage Your Award](https://www.nsf.gov/awards/request-a-change): Guide to requesting award modifications including no-cost extensions and PI changes
- [Report Your Progress and Outcomes - Manage Your Award](https://www.nsf.gov/awards/report-your-outcomes): Instructions for reporting progress, outcomes, and annual reports for NSF awards
